what: Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group is Japan's largest bank. It lends to companies and households, runs trust banking and securities businesses, and owns a large stake in Morgan Stanley.
customers: Japanese companies and households and corporate clients across Asia and the US.
money: lending and services to large companies
moat: The largest deposit base in Japan and a broad international network.
opportunities: Revenue grew about 15% last year with a 25% net margin
The Bank of Japan ending negative rates lifts income on its very large deposit base directly
Selling cross-shareholdings in client companies releases capital for buybacks
watch: Domestic net interest income as Japanese rates move, and the pace of share buybacks.
